name: nibrin

function.text: NBN encodes nibrin. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor binding and chromatin-protein adaptor activity. It participates in homologous recombination and telomere maintenance.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include Nijmegen breakage syndrome (autosomal recessive). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.
